title: 第十一章 萧野留下的大礼第十二章 灵力化海炼气九层
content_zh:
来人虽然身着黑衣，但却没有故意遮住自己的脸，显然在他看来，以天罡境初期的修为杀炼气六层的萧凉是用牛刀杀鸡。
可是出手之后才发现，萧凉不论是灵力方面，还是剑道方面的领悟，都是极为恐怖的。
这根本不像是炼气六层能拥有的灵力，最为恐怖的是那剑意，他的兵器削铁如泥，可却没有接住萧凉的随手一击。
“苏家派你来的？还是陈君浩，亦或是凌霄阁？”萧凉背负双手，立在屋门之前，灵力运转，形成一个动态的平衡。
黑衣人寻找萧凉破绽所在，企图一击毙命，但他根本找不到萧凉的破绽所在。
就算是偶然出现破绽，却又瞬间换了位置。
二人僵持片刻之后，黑衣人额头上已然有细汗冒出。
今日前来杀萧凉，他的主人已经告诉他，萧凉接连接住天罡境巅峰的攻击，而且还令天罡境巅峰的高手受伤。
当时他只觉得是主子怕他大意，这才故意说给他听让他全力以赴。
一个炼气六层的蝼蚁，如何配他全力出手？
是以他接下任务之后，几乎没有任何准备便来了萧家，谁曾想到萧凉竟然厉害至此，若是萧凉再次催动无形剑意，他该如何来抵挡？
“剑意来自无量剑，以我当下的修为能催动使用的极少，眼下我的确占据了上方，但灵力方面与对方的确相差太大，要解决掉这个杀手，只能智取！”
萧凉当时能伤到那天罡境巅峰的高手，完全是因为出其不意，现在与真正的天罡境交手，纵然只是天罡境初期，也让他感觉到无比棘手。
二人各怀心思，气机不住交锋，一时间却是僵持住了，谁也没能占据上方。
轰隆隆！
惊雷炸响，闪电横空，萧凉和黑衣人同时出现破绽，他们各自眼睛皆是猛地一睁，跃向空中。
萧凉再次催动无量剑意，化作一道光点激射而出。
黑衣人一声怒吼，断剑挥动斩下。
无形之剑与有形之剑撞上，顿然发出刺耳的铿锵之声。
紊乱劲力呼啸开去，如水波一般。

二人皆是用完了一口气，从空中徐徐降落。
可就在萧凉双脚着地的瞬间，他如同离弦箭矢，陡然间激射而出。
黑衣人还没有反应过来，一抹寒光已然划过他的脖子。
鲜血飞溅，黑衣人倒在了地上，他眼睛睁得大大的，从未想到自己会这般轻而易举的死了。
“正面交手，我的确不是你的对手，但是杀人从来都不只是靠修为的！”
萧凉的声音透着一股难以形容的冰冷，不带任何情感。
可惜，黑衣人已经听不到了。
恰在这时，萧林走了进来，看到那倒在地上的黑衣人，萧林面色刷的一白，“少爷，这是？”
“家里进了贼，被我收拾了！”萧凉淡淡说道。
萧林不由一惊，问道：“那我们需要向顺天府报案吗？”
content_en:
Although the visitor was dressed in black, he did not cover his face intentionally. Obviously, in his opinion, killing Xiao Liang, who was at the sixth level of Qi Refining with his early Tiangang realm cultivation, was killing a chicken with a bull's-eye.
But after taking action, he discovered that Xiao Liang's spiritual power and swordsmanship were extremely terrifying.
This is not like the spiritual power that can be possessed by the sixth level of Qi Refining. The most terrifying thing is the sword intention. His weapon cuts iron like clay, but he did not catch Xiao Liang's casual blow.
"Did the Su family send you here? Or Chen Junhao, or Lingxiao Pavilion?" Xiao Liang stood in front of the door with his hands behind his back, and his spiritual power was running to form a dynamic balance.
The man in black looked for Xiao Liang's weakness and tried to kill him with one blow, but he couldn't find Xiao Liang's weakness at all.
Even if there is a flaw by chance, it changes position instantly.
After the two were in a stalemate for a while, sweat began to break out on the man in black's forehead.
When he came to kill Xiao Liang today, his master had already told him that Xiao Liang had continuously received attacks from the top of the Tiangang Realm, and also injured the masters at the top of the Tiangang Realm.
At that time, he just thought that his master was afraid that he would be careless, so he deliberately told him to let him go all out.
How can an ant at the sixth level of Qi refining match his full strength?
So after he accepted the mission, he came to the Xiao family with almost no preparation. Who would have thought that Xiao Liang was so powerful? If Xiao Liang activated the invisible sword intention again, how would he resist it?
"The sword intention comes from the Infinite Sword. With my current cultivation level, there are very few that can be used. I do occupy the top right now, but there is a big gap in spiritual power with the opponent. To deal with this killer, I can only outwit him!"
Xiao Liang was able to hurt a master at the peak of Tiangang Realm at that time entirely because of surprise. Now he was fighting against a real Tiangang Realm master, even if he was only at the early stage of Tiangang Realm, it still felt extremely difficult for him.
The two of them had their own thoughts and couldn't help but fight, but for a while they were in a stalemate, and neither one could take the upper hand.
Boom!
Thunder exploded and lightning flashed across the sky. Xiao Liang and the man in black appeared to have flaws at the same time. Their eyes suddenly opened and they jumped into the air.
Xiao Liang once again activated the Infinite Sword Intent, turning into a point of light and shooting out.
The man in black roared angrily and swung his broken sword down.
The invisible sword collided with the visible sword and suddenly made a harsh clanging sound.
The chaotic energy roared away like water waves.
Both of them exhausted their breath and slowly landed from the sky.
But the moment Xiao Liang's feet touched the ground, he suddenly shot out like an arrow from the string.
Before the man in black could react, a cold light had already crossed his neck.
Blood spattered and the man in black fell to the ground. His eyes were wide open. He never thought that he would die so easily.
"In a head-to-head fight, I am indeed no match for you, but killing is never just about cultivation!"
Xiao Liang's voice was indescribably cold and devoid of any emotion.
Unfortunately, the man in black could no longer hear him.
Just at this moment, Xiao Lin walked in. When he saw the man in black lying on the ground, Xiao Lin's face turned pale, "Master, what is this?"
"There was a thief in the house, and I took care of him!" Xiao Liang said lightly.
Xiao Lin couldn't help being surprised and asked: "Then do we need to report the case to Shuntian Mansion?"
